title: 第7章 洗劫第8章 树倒猢狲散
content_zh:
随着陆毅的离开，陆宸坐了起来，仅用了两分钟就把饭吃完了，之后便回到了石珠世界。
从早上回到房间的那一瞬间，陆宸就意识到石珠世界和外界世界的时间流速不一样。
他清晰的记得，他在石珠世界待了整整四天，然而，外界却仅仅只过了一个晚上。
外界一个晚上石珠世界过了四天，折算一下，石珠世界的时间大概就是外界的十倍，外界一天，石珠世界十天。
也正是发现了这一点，陆宸对未来充满了希望，不管是四大家族，还是城主府，曾经他们给他的，他都将十倍，甚至百倍的拿回来。
进入石珠世界后，陆宸潜心修炼了起来，很快，他的武道顺势突破到了四重武徒境。
同一时间，随着武道境界的提升，石珠世界的疆域不断扩大，足足比之前广阔了四分之一。
石珠世界的疆域会随着实力的提升不断扩张的猜测得到证实，陆宸很开心，不过，很快另一个问题摆在了他的面前。
在突破四重武徒境后，他体内的混沌能量团彻底被炼化了，如今的他手上又没有一点修炼资源。
对武者而言，汲取天地间的灵气修行武道提升速度极慢，没有修炼资源就意味着武道无法提升。
不久后，陆宸回到了外界，躺在床上思考了起来。
因为上一世丹、武双修，陆宸刚重生，魂力就比一般人强大了数倍，差不多达到一品炼丹师的魂力。
到了晚上，等到所有人休息，陆宸释放出了魂力，在确定没人暗中偷窥后，他走出了房间。
之后，陆宸一步踏出，随着脚下一点星芒的出现，陆宸出现在了十米之外，没一会便离开了陆家。
功法也分等级，从低到高分别为黄级、玄级、地级、天级和神级，其中每个等级又分上中下三品。
此时，陆宸施展的身法武技叫凌霄步，是陆宸上一世自创的天级中品身法武技，修炼到极致，速度堪比星辰坠落。
从陆家出来，陆宸轻车熟路的来到了街上，在穿过一条条街道后，他来到了一个商铺前。
这个商铺牌匾上写着灵药堂三个字，是四大家族之一林家设立的一个商铺，主卖各种灵药。
今夜，这个灵药堂就是陆宸的目标，陆宸要打劫它，从这个商铺获得灵晶，也算是提前向林家收一点利息。
靠近灵药堂，陆宸释放出魂力，紧接着，方圆五十米范围内的一切出现清晰的出现在陆宸的脑海中。

或许是因为灵药堂的灵药价值比较高，林家居然安排了六个人看铺子，四个伙计都是武徒境，掌柜的三重武士境，楼上还住着一个一重武师境的强者。
摸清楚情况，陆宸眉头皱了起来，现在的他武道只有四重武徒境，就是手段尽出，战力也就是武士境出头。
面对对方六个人，其中还有两个武士境以上实力的“强者”
，他今天想要得手不太可能了。
content_en:
As Lu Yi left, Lu Chen sat up, finished his meal in just two minutes, and then returned to the world of Shizhu.
From the moment he returned to his room in the morning, Lu Chen realized that the time flow rate in the Shizhu world was different from that in the outside world.
He clearly remembered that he stayed in Shizhu World for four full days, but the outside world only lasted one night.
One night in the outside world takes four days in the Shizhu World. If you calculate it, the time in the Shizhu World is about ten times that of the outside world. One day in the outside world means ten days in the Shizhu World.
It was precisely after discovering this that Lu Chen was full of hope for the future. Whether it was the four major families or the city lord's mansion, he would get back ten times or even a hundred times what they had given him.
After entering the world of stone beads, Lu Chen devoted himself to training. Soon, his martial arts broke through to the fourth level of martial arts.
At the same time, with the improvement of martial arts realm, the territory of Shizhu World continued to expand, becoming a quarter wider than before.
The speculation that the territory of the Shizhu World would continue to expand as its strength increased was confirmed. Lu Chen was very happy, but soon another problem was placed in front of him.
After breaking through to the fourth level of warrior realm, the chaotic energy group in his body was completely refined, and now he has no training resources at hand.
For warriors, absorbing the spiritual energy between heaven and earth to practice martial arts improves very slowly. Without training resources, it means that martial arts cannot be improved.
Soon after, Lu Chen returned to the outside world, lying on the bed and thinking.
Because of his dual cultivation of Dan and Wu in his previous life, Lu Chen's soul power was several times stronger than that of an ordinary person as soon as he was reborn, almost reaching the soul power of a first-grade alchemist.
At night, after everyone had rested, Lu Chen released his soul power. After making sure that no one was spying on him, he walked out of the room.
After that, Lu Chen took a step forward, and as a star appeared under his feet, Lu Chen appeared ten meters away, and left the Lu family after a while.
Kung Fu is also divided into levels. From low to high, they are Yellow Level, Xuan Level, Earth Level, Heaven Level and God Level. Each level is divided into upper, middle and lower grades.
At this time, the movement martial arts Lu Chen performed was called Lingxiao Bu. It was a heaven-level mid-grade movement martial arts created by Lu Chen in his previous life. After practicing to the extreme, his speed was comparable to the falling stars.
After coming out of Lu's house, Lu Chen came to the street with ease. After passing through the streets, he came to a shop.
The word "Elixir Hall" is written on the plaque of this shop. It is a shop set up by the Lin family, one of the four major families, and sells various elixirs.
Tonight, this spiritual medicine hall is Lu Chen's target. Lu Chen wants to rob it and obtain spiritual crystals from this shop, which can be regarded as collecting some interest from the Lin family in advance.
Approaching the Spiritual Medicine Hall, Lu Chen released his soul power, and then everything within a radius of fifty meters appeared clearly in Lu Chen's mind.
Perhaps because the elixirs in the elixir hall are of relatively high value, the Lin family actually arranged for six people to look after the shop. The four clerks are all martial arts disciples, the shopkeeper is a third-level warrior, and there is a strong man who is a first-level martial artist living upstairs.
After figuring out the situation, Lu Chen frowned. His current martial arts was only at the fourth level of the martial arts disciple level, which meant that he could use all his means and his combat power was only at the level of the warrior level.
Facing six opponents, there are two "strong men" with strength above the warrior level.
, it is impossible for him to succeed today.
